title: Question 6
passage: A. Some tools are hanging from a wall bracket. B. A wheel has been removed from a cart. C. A cart is being loaded into a van. D. Several long-handled tools are sticking out of a cart.
passageZh:
A. 有幾件工具掛在牆上的掛架上。
B. 推車有一個輪子被拆了。
C. 有人正在把推車裝進廂型車。
D. 幾件長柄工具從推車裡伸出來。
